RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "We have measured parent behavior probes. Need interpret." and "Parent slot 7 is TFT with forgiveness/probing. It scored high. We can improve by:"
STRATEGY: Parent is TFT with forgiveness/probing; probes simulate one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D after ten CC rounds; trace proposes adding exploitation of allC and periodic_D, better handling of initial defections, and model-based responsiveness detection.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent cooperates mostly on first D (0.925 own cooperation first4 for one_D_TFT). So we should keep that." and "Parent got 0.7667 per round = ~76. So we improve." and "Parent got 1.9875. So similar."
STRATEGY: The parent is a TFT-like strategy that cooperates on the first unprovoked defection and retaliates on later ones. The trace simulates the parent against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, and periodic_D, and proposes a run-length rule (cooperate on run=1, defect on run=2/3, cooperate on run=4, defect on run>=5) plus a CC-streak probe to exploit non-responsive opponents.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE

RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these measurements when deciding what to retain or change to maximize cumulative tournament fitness."
STRATEGY: Parent uses a run-length rule for opponent defections and a CC-streak probe; the trace simulates TFT, one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, and periodic_D; it changes the probe threshold to 15 CC rounds and adds a last-round defection.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Parent got 1.9875. Huge improvement!" and "So our strategy dramatically improves all probes except one_D_TFT where we improve slightly, and four_D_TFT where we improve a lot."
STRATEGY: Parent is a rule-based strategy that cooperates initially, defects on the last round, probes after 20 consecutive CC rounds, and uses run-length rules for opponent defections. Simulated against the probe opponents (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) and computed scores. Changed the probe threshold from 15 to 20 consecutive CC rounds.
